summary: Tennis tournament Tennis tournament 2022 Elle Spirit Open Date 5–11 September 2022 Edition 5th Category ITF Women's World Tennis Tour Prize money $60,000 Surface Clay / Outdoor Location Montreux , Switzerland Champions Singles Tamara Korpatsch Doubles Inès Ibbou / Naïma Karamoko ← 2021 · Montreux Ladies Open · 2023 → The 2022 Elle Spirit Open was a professional tennis tournament played on outdoor clay courts . It was the fifth edition of the tournament which was part of the 2022 ITF Women's World Tennis Tour . It took place in Montreux , Switzerland between 5 and 11 September 2022.
